$comment: Connection-compatibility semantics (SUB-005). The permitted-cast TABLE lives in the structural catalog (node-catalog.json#/typecasts) and is exported by the runtime itself (packages/noodl-runtime/src/nodelibraryexport.js); this file documents what the rules and each cast MEAN. scripts/node-catalog/merge.js fails if castSemantics ever drifts from the catalog table, and asserts every verifiedPairs entry against the rule implementation.

rules.gate: The editor permits a connection from output type F to input type T iff: F === T, or F === '*', or T === '*', or the typecast table has an entry {from: F, to: [... T ...]}. This is NodeLibrary.canCastPortTypes (packages/noodl-editor/src/editor/src/models/nodelibrary/nodelibrary.ts).
rules.wildcard: The type '*' (untyped) connects to and from anything. Many dynamic ports (Function/Expression outputs, Object properties) are untyped; the editor will accept any wiring to them, so correctness is the author's responsibility.
rules.delivery: The runtime performs no central value conversion on delivery: the raw output value is handed to the receiving input, whose setter coerces it (usually with plain JavaScript semantics). A permitted cast means 'the receiver knows what to do with this', not 'a converter runs on the wire'.
rules.allowConnectionsOnly: Ports typed with allowConnectionsOnly can only be driven by a connection, never set statically via parameters.
rules.allowEditOnly: Ports typed with allowEditOnly can only be set via parameters, never connected.

signalSemantics.firing: A signal output fires by sending the value true immediately followed by false (Node.prototype.sendSignalOnOutput, packages/noodl-runtime/src/node.js). A signal is a momentary event with no payload.
signalSemantics.receiving: A signal input triggers when its incoming value transitions to true (valueChangedToTrue) — it is edge-triggered, not level-sensitive. Holding a value at true does not re-trigger.
signalSemantics.suppression: A signal output that already fired in the current update cycle is suppressed from firing again until the cycle completes, preventing infinite loops within one frame.
signalSemantics.authoring: Wire signals to signals ('On Click' → 'Do'). Wiring a boolean to a signal input is legal and means 'trigger once on the rising edge'. Wiring a signal to a boolean input is legal and delivers a true-then-false pulse — useful for momentary states, wrong for latching ones.

castSemantics.string→number: Receiver coerces with JavaScript numeric conversion; non-numeric strings become NaN. Prefer a Number value if the source is numeric to begin with.
castSemantics.string→boolean: JavaScript truthiness: empty string is false, any other string (including 'false') is true.
castSemantics.string→image: The string is used as an image source: a project asset path or a URL.
castSemantics.string→color: The string is used as a color value: a project style-color name or any CSS color string ('#ff0000', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)').
castSemantics.string→enum: The string must equal one of the input's enum values (the value, not the label); anything else leaves the input unchanged or misconfigured.
castSemantics.string→textStyle: The string names a project text style.
castSemantics.string→dimension: Parsed as a CSS dimension: a bare number is treated as px; '50%' selects percent units.
castSemantics.string→array: The string is passed through unchanged. This cast exists for inputs that accept a named/shared collection id in place of an actual array (legacy Collection semantics). Do not expect JSON parsing.
castSemantics.string→object: The string is passed through unchanged. This cast exists for inputs that accept a Model/Object id in place of the object itself; the receiver resolves the id to the shared object.
castSemantics.boolean→number: true → 1, false → 0 by JavaScript coercion in the receiver.
castSemantics.boolean→signal: Edge trigger: the signal input fires once each time the boolean transitions from false to true. A boolean that is already true when connected does not fire it retroactively.
castSemantics.number→boolean: JavaScript truthiness: 0 and NaN are false, everything else true.
castSemantics.number→string: Decimal string form of the number.
castSemantics.number→dimension: The number is used as a pixel value.
castSemantics.date→string: The receiver converts the Date with JavaScript string coercion.
castSemantics.signal→boolean: The boolean input receives a true-then-false pulse each time the signal fires. Use for momentary behaviour only; the value does not stay true.
castSemantics.signal→number: The number input receives 1 then 0 each firing (boolean pulse coerced numerically). Rarely what you want; prefer States or a Counter.
castSemantics.cloudfile→string: The cloud file's URL as a string.
castSemantics.cloudfile→image: The cloud file is used as an image source (its URL).
castSemantics.textStyle→string: The text style's name as a string.
castSemantics.collection→array: Collection (legacy shared-list type) and array are interchangeable: the same underlying list object flows through unchanged.
castSemantics.array→collection: Array and collection (legacy shared-list type) are interchangeable: the same underlying list object flows through unchanged.
castSemantics.object→string: The runtime serialises with JSON.stringify before the receiver's cast runs (NDA-014, PORT-TYPE-CONTRACT.md). Values with their own toString (e.g. Date) keep that rendering; circular structures deliver '' and raise a warning.
castSemantics.array→string: The runtime serialises with JSON.stringify before the receiver's cast runs (NDA-014, PORT-TYPE-CONTRACT.md). Circular structures deliver '' and raise a warning.
castSemantics.color→string: The resolved color string — a style name resolves to its value (context.styles.resolveColor) before crossing the wire.

verifiedPairs.$comment: Sampled pairs asserted by scripts/node-catalog/merge.js against the gate rule + the catalog typecast table on every merge/check. 'permitted' must pass canCastPortTypes; 'rejected' must fail it.

permitted.note: rising-edge trigger — the idiomatic 'run when this becomes true'
must match an enum value exactly

rejected.note: numbers do not edge-trigger; go via boolean
date only casts to string; use an Expression for timestamps
strings never trigger signals; go via boolean
